author: Vishal-k
quote:
Rating: 1/10

Honestly, one of the biggest disappointments in the entire GTA franchise.

The world-building and NPCs are genuinely impressive. The map is beautiful, the environment feels alive, and Rockstar has clearly put a lot of effort into creating an immersive world. Unfortunately, that's where the appreciation ends.

Lucia and Jason are, in my opinion, two of the weakest protagonists the GTA franchise has ever had. Their characters, personalities, and overall dynamic are incredibly frustrating. The story is painfully disappointing, filled with stupid character decisions and an uninteresting relationship dynamic. I genuinely question why this story was even made part of the GTA franchise.

The gameplay doesn't help either. Instead of feeling like an exciting GTA experience, it often feels like a collection of mundane everyday chores. Buying flowers, grocery shopping, washing cars, going on dates and doing other pointless activities don't automatically make a game immersive or entertaining. At times, the gameplay feels awkward, tedious and downright stupid.

The only real saving grace is the beautifully designed world and its atmosphere. But even that comes with a frustrating number of bugs.

A beautiful world cannot compensate for a terrible story, unlikeable protagonists and disappointing gameplay.

For me, this is nowhere near what a GTA game should be. The franchise deserved much better.
